outcome: Cesarean section for intrapartum fetal compromise (CS-IFC)
cohort: 429 normotensive women with appropriately grown, non-anomalous, singleton pregnancies
finding: Combining UtA-PI >95th centile and CPR <10th centile showed modest screening performance for CS-IFC and CNM in low-risk pregnant women.
mod_finding: The combination of UtA-PI 95th centile, CPR 10th centile, and EFW 10th centile had the highest sensitivity for predicting CNM.
